context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly stops questioning the moment the user gives an explicit override, rather than persisting with a planned question sequence.

checklist.name: First question well-formed
checklist.description: The first question offers 3-4 concrete options with tradeoffs before the override happens

checklist.name: Stops immediately on override
checklist.description: No further branching question is asked after the user says 'just decide for me'

checklist.name: States default assumptions
checklist.description: The agent explicitly states the assumptions it will use in place of the unanswered questions

checklist.name: Recap still produced
checklist.description: A recap combining actual answers and stated assumptions is presented before the final recommendation

checklist.name: Acknowledges the override
checklist.description: The response acknowledges the user's 'just decide' signal rather than silently changing behavior
